newsitem.title: UK: Hyder adds 50 million stg to 2006 bond.
newsitem.headline: Hyder adds 50 million stg to 2006 bond.

text.p: Hyder Plc has added 50 million stg, priced at 106.334, to its 8.75 percent July 2006 bond, sole manager HSBC Markets said on Tuesday.
Fees total two points. The deal was originally launched as a 150 million stg offering at a 68 basis points reoffer spread on June 28, 1996.
